title: Public project and repository reference for MLSLabsRenderer-Lite
summary: On 2026-07-29, the MLSLabsRenderer-Lite development line was recorded with links to its public project website and the MLSLabs Gaussian Splatting Renderer UE repository. Taken only from the dated links, this establishes a traceable public reference point for the project's renderer development, but does not establish a specific release, feature set, or version.
